1//! Pattern dictionary segment parsing and decoding (7.4.4, 6.7).
2
3use super::{AdaptiveTemplatePixel, Template, generic};
4use crate::third_party::hayro_jbig2::ScratchBuffers;
5use crate::third_party::hayro_jbig2::arithmetic_decoder::{ArithmeticDecoder, ArithmeticDecoderContext};
6use crate::third_party::hayro_jbig2::bitmap::{Bitmap, WORD_BITS, Word, copy_work};
7use crate::third_party::hayro_jbig2::error::{OverflowError, ParseError, Result};
8use crate::third_party::hayro_jbig2::reader::Reader;
9use alloc::vec::Vec;
10
11/// PdfCraft patch: the most words of shifted copies a dictionary keeps, 16 MiB, where 256 patterns
12/// of 32 rows take 2 MiB. A 48-byte dictionary of 65,535 such patterns asked for 539 MB.
13const MAX_SHIFTED_WORDS: u64 = 1 << 22;
14
15/// Decode a pattern dictionary segment (7.4.4.2, 6.7).
16pub(crate) fn decode(header: &PatternDictionaryHeader<'_>, scratch: &mut ScratchBuffers, room: u64) -> Result<PatternDictionary> {
17    let pattern_width = header.pattern_width as u32;
18    let pattern_height = header.pattern_height as u32;
19    let num_patterns = header.num_patterns.checked_add(1).ok_or(OverflowError::BitmapDimension)?;
20
21    // "1) Create a bitmap B_HDC. The height of this bitmap is HDPH. The width
22    // of the bitmap is (GRAYMAX + 1) × HDPW. This bitmap contains all the
23    // patterns concatenated left to right." (6.7.5)
24    let collective_width = num_patterns.checked_mul(pattern_width).ok_or(OverflowError::BitmapDimension)?;
25
26    let mut collective_bitmap = Bitmap::new(collective_width, pattern_height)?;
27
28    // "2) Decode the collective bitmap using a generic region decoding procedure
29    // as described in 6.2." (6.7.5)
30    if header.mmr {
31        let _ = generic::decode_bitmap_mmr(&mut collective_bitmap, header.data)?;
32    } else {
33        let at_pixels = match header.template {
34            Template::Template0 => [
35                AdaptiveTemplatePixel { x: -(pattern_width as i8), y: 0 },
36                AdaptiveTemplatePixel { x: -3, y: -1 },
37                AdaptiveTemplatePixel { x: 2, y: -2 },
38                AdaptiveTemplatePixel { x: -2, y: -2 },
39            ],
40            Template::Template1 | Template::Template2 | Template::Template3 => [
41                AdaptiveTemplatePixel { x: -(pattern_width as i8), y: 0 },
42                // Unused.
43                AdaptiveTemplatePixel::default(),
44                AdaptiveTemplatePixel::default(),
45                AdaptiveTemplatePixel::default(),
46            ],
47        };
48
49        let mut decoder = ArithmeticDecoder::new(header.data);
50        scratch.contexts.clear();
51        scratch.contexts.resize(1 << header.template.context_bits(), ArithmeticDecoderContext::default());
52
53        generic::decode_bitmap_arithmetic_coding(&mut collective_bitmap, &mut decoder, &mut scratch.contexts, header.template, false, &at_pixels)?;
54    }
55
56    // "3) Set: GRAY = 0" (6.7.5)
57    // "4) While GRAY ≤ GRAYMAX:" (6.7.5)
58    let mut patterns = Vec::with_capacity(num_patterns as usize);
59
60    let src_stride = collective_bitmap.stride;
61
62    for gray in 0..num_patterns {
63        // "a) Let the subimage of B_HDC consisting of HPH rows and columns
64        // HDPW × GRAY through HDPW × (GRAY + 1) − 1 be denoted B_P. Set:
65        // HDPATS[GRAY] = B_P" (6.7.5)"
66        let start_x = gray * pattern_width;
67        let mut pattern = Bitmap::new(pattern_width, pattern_height)?;
68
69        let src_word_idx = start_x / WORD_BITS;
70        let src_bit_offset = start_x % WORD_BITS;
71        let dst_stride = pattern.stride;
72
73        for y in 0..pattern_height {
74            let src_row = (y * src_stride + src_word_idx) as usize;
75            let dst_row = (y * dst_stride) as usize;
76
77            for w in 0..dst_stride {
78                let s1 = collective_bitmap.data[src_row + w as usize];
79                let s2 = collective_bitmap.data.get(src_row + w as usize + 1).copied().unwrap_or(0);
80
81                let word: Word = if src_bit_offset == 0 { s1 } else { (s1 << src_bit_offset) | (s2 >> (WORD_BITS - src_bit_offset)) };
82
83                pattern.data[dst_row + w as usize] = word;
84            }
85
86            // Clear trailing bits in the last word beyond `pattern_width`.
87            let trailing = pattern_width % WORD_BITS;
88            if trailing != 0 {
89                let last = dst_row + (dst_stride - 1) as usize;
90                pattern.data[last] &= !0 << (WORD_BITS - trailing);
91            }
92        }
93
94        patterns.push(pattern);
95    }
96
97    // It turns out that when rendering patterns, the `Bitmap::combine` operation
98    // can often be a huge bottleneck. This is because we need to do a lot of
99    // fiddling to compose the patterns in the right position. And since
100    // if a page uses such patterns, there's going to be a lot of them,
101    // this takes up a lot of time.
102    //
103    // The key insight for our optimization is that patterns are usually
104    // very small. Therefore, we precompute a new version of each pattern
105    // for all possible 32-bit alignments, which later on allows us to
106    // very easily blit it into the backdrop, significantly speeding up
107    // the whole process.
108    //
109    // PdfCraft patch: only when the table is small, and fits what the page may still hold
110    // (`room`), so that a speed-up never gets an image refused. It can be left out:
111    // `shifted_pattern` then returns `None` and the patterns are combined the slow way.
112    let shifted_words = (patterns.len() as u64).saturating_mul(32 * 2).saturating_mul(u64::from(pattern_height));
113    let pattern_words = patterns.iter().map(|p| p.words() as u64).fold(0, u64::saturating_add);
114    let shifted_patterns = if pattern_width <= WORD_BITS
115        && pattern_height <= WORD_BITS
116        && shifted_words <= MAX_SHIFTED_WORDS
117        && shifted_words.saturating_add(pattern_words) <= room
118    {
119        let h = pattern_height as usize;
120        let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(patterns.len() * 32 * h * 2);
121        for pattern in &patterns {
122            for k in 0..32_u32 {
123                for y in 0..h {
124                    let word = pattern.data[y];
125                    if k == 0 {
126                        data.push(word);
127                        data.push(0);
128                    } else {
129                        data.push(word >> k);
130                        data.push(word << (WORD_BITS - k));
131                    }
132                }
133            }
134        }
135        data
136    } else {
137        Vec::new()
138    };
139
140    Ok(PatternDictionary { patterns, pattern_width, pattern_height, shifted_patterns })
141}
142
143/// A decoded pattern dictionary.
144#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
145pub(crate) struct PatternDictionary {
146    pub(crate) patterns: Vec<Bitmap>,
147    pub(crate) pattern_width: u32,
148    pub(crate) pattern_height: u32,
149    shifted_patterns: Vec<Word>,
150}
151
152impl PatternDictionary {
153    #[inline(always)]
154    pub(crate) fn shifted_pattern(&self, pattern_idx: usize, bit_offset: u32) -> Option<&[Word]> {
155        let h = self.pattern_height as usize;
156        let len = h * 2;
157        let start = (pattern_idx * 32 + bit_offset as usize) * len;
158        self.shifted_patterns.get(start..start + len)
159    }
160
161    /// PdfCraft patch: the words the dictionary holds, its patterns and their shifted copies.
162    pub(crate) fn words(&self) -> usize {
163        self.patterns.iter().map(Bitmap::words).fold(self.shifted_patterns.len(), usize::saturating_add)
164    }
165}

167/// Parsed pattern dictionary segment header (7.4.4.1).
168#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
169pub(crate) struct PatternDictionaryHeader<'a> {
170    pub(crate) mmr: bool,
171    pub(crate) template: Template,
172    /// `HDPW`
173    pub(crate) pattern_width: u8,
174    /// `HDPH`
175    pub(crate) pattern_height: u8,
176    /// `GRAYMAX`
177    pub(crate) num_patterns: u32,
178    pub(crate) data: &'a [u8],
179}
180
181impl PatternDictionaryHeader<'_> {
182    /// PdfCraft patch: the work of decoding the patterns, side by side in one bitmap, and of
183    /// taking each out of it (see `bitmap::MAX_WORK`).
184    pub(crate) fn work(&self) -> u64 {
185        let (width, height) = (u32::from(self.pattern_width), u32::from(self.pattern_height));
186        let patterns = u64::from(self.num_patterns) + 1;
187        let side_by_side = u64::from(height) * (patterns.saturating_mul(u64::from(width)) + 4);
188        side_by_side.saturating_add(patterns.saturating_mul(copy_work(width, height)))
189    }
190}
191
192/// Parse a pattern dictionary segment header (7.4.4.1).
193pub(crate) fn parse<'a>(reader: &mut Reader<'a>) -> Result<PatternDictionaryHeader<'a>> {
194    let flags_byte = reader.read_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
195    let mmr = flags_byte & 0x01 != 0;
196    let template = Template::from_byte(flags_byte >> 1);
197    let pattern_width = reader.read_nonzero_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
198    let pattern_height = reader.read_nonzero_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
199    let num_patterns = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
200    let data = reader.tail().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
201
202    Ok(PatternDictionaryHeader { mmr, template, pattern_width, pattern_height, num_patterns, data })
203}
